title: fix(pm): fleet-roster reads a shared-account seat's own activity
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #28906
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:车队总表的「最近活动」改读席位自己的痕迹(座位贴、在飞卡、本席信箱 PR、近 6 小时署名为本席的评论),同账号多席里的高位席不再被误标「疑似撞墙」。
- **为什么改**:一个账号坐同车道多席是规则允许的并发,但高位席没有自己的在飞卡,总表只剩座位贴时间可看,把 server 车道 2、3、5 席误判为撞墙,真撞墙被淹没。
- **风险与回滚**:只改一个只读视图脚本 `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`,不发布;每次生成多一个分页读(今日约 4 页);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` 中 `buildRows` 的 `times` 一行与 `signedActivity`;其次 `SIGNATURE_LINE` 镜像及其等值自测。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`,预期 `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 104 cases in 9 batteries pass.`
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` only (+109 / -11).

- **Last activity is the newest of the seat's own traces**: the seat post's `updated_at`, its in-flight cards, its mailbox pull's `updated_at` (the mailbox column's pull, already in the `pulls?state=open` read, so no new call), and every comment of the last `STALE_HOURS` whose first non-empty line is a seat signature `LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION` naming THIS row's lane and seat number. The attribution is by seat, never by account, so two seats on one account stay apart.
- **The in-flight column is unchanged**: a seat whose account holds a lower seat of its lane still reads `= seat N`. `STALE_HOURS` is unchanged (6).
- **One new read per repo**: `GET /repos/R/issues/comments?since=(now − 6 h)`, paged through `gh-pages.mjs`. The footer of the generated body names it with the other reads.
- **The signature pattern is mirrored, not imported**: the relay imports `ROSTER_MARKER` from this file, so it must not load `check-half-states.mjs` (the same reason `isEpicParent` mirrors H45). The self-test holds `SIGNATURE_LINE` byte-equal to `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` (source and flags) and checks `signedSeatOf` against `readSignatureLine` over a corpus.

## Tests

New self-test battery `one account on two seats of a lane: the second seat reads its own traces` (13 cases, battery floor 8 → 9). The cases:

- With no trace of its own, seat 2 reads `= seat 1` and its post alone, and is flagged.
- A fresh mailbox pull lifts the flag. A fresh comment signed `domain:server#2` lifts it too.
- When the mailbox and the signed comment are both older than `STALE_HOURS`, the seat is flagged.
- Seat 1's fresh signed comment and fresh mailbox (same account) leave seat 2 flagged.
- These sign nothing for the seat: another lane's seat 2, a signature that is not the first non-empty line, and a misspelled signature.
- The newest of the four traces wins.
- The rendered row keeps `= seat 1` without the flag.
- The read window is `STALE_HOURS`, and the footer names the read.

<details><summary>Self-test and suites run on 01dbcd7b3b</summary>

```
node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
✓ fleet-roster self-test: 104 cases in 9 batteries pass.
node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test :: exit 0   (imports ROSTER_MARKER from this file)
✓ fleet-write/dispatch self-test: 265 cases pass across 24 batteries
pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers :: exit 0   (runs fleet-roster --self-test)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The mailbox share counts inbound doorbells.** A mailbox pull's `updated_at` moves on any comment, including another seat's `To:` line, so a walled seat that keeps receiving doorbells reads fresh. The card's Wanted names the mailbox, so it is in. A signed comment is the stricter trace, because it is attributed to its writer.
- **The comment read stops at `STALE_HOURS`.** The flag is exact. For a flagged row, a signed comment older than 6 h is not read, so the age cell can read older than that comment. The read window keeps the cost bounded: 388 comments in 6 h today against a 5000-row `MAX_PAGES` guard. A 24 h window measured 1720 comments and 18 pages.
- Only comments on repos in `--repos` are read. A `repo:cloud` seat's signed comments land on the cloud repo, so those rows still read their post alone.
- In this session hotcrm answers 403, so the live runs used `--repos objectstack-ai/objectstack,objectstack-ai/objectui`. The default three-repo run fails at hotcrm here before and after this change.

## Verification

Live, read-only, before at `origin/main` 9a9823d921 and after on this branch:

| seat | post | before (last activity · flag) | after (last activity · flag) | after: mailbox pull · newest signed comment |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `domain:server#2` | #20966 | 2026-10-31T02:56Z · 疑似撞墙 | 2026-11-02T04:27Z · none | #28284 04:03Z · 04:27Z |
| `domain:server#3` | #26761 | 2026-11-01T06:46Z · 疑似撞墙 | 2026-11-02T04:07Z · none | #28585 03:49Z · 04:07Z |
| `domain:server#5` | #28677 | 2026-11-01T13:13Z · 疑似撞墙 | 2026-11-02T04:16Z · none | #28678 03:50Z · 04:16Z |

The run flagged 9 rows before and 6 after. The other six flags are unchanged: `repo:cloud` 1 and 2, `repo:docs.objectos.ai` 1, `domain:spec` 3 and 5, and `repo:www.objectos.ai` 1. Each server seat's mailbox and its signed comment are both fresh, so either trace alone lifts its flag. Seat 1 keeps its 9 in-flight cards, and seats 2, 3 and 5 still read `= seat 1`.

**API cost**: the run made 23 `gh api` calls after the change and 18 before. The 5 new calls are the comment reads: 4 pages on objectstack and 1 on objectui.
